description: This file defines the SSECMiddleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) in S3 operations. It provides methods to wrap handlers, prepare encryption parameters, and enforce HTTPS usage for security.

classes.name: SSECMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling SSE-C encryption key processing, including base64 encoding and MD5 hash generation, to facilitate secure communication with AWS S3.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method returning a handler that wraps the next handler with the SSE-C middleware, configured with the URI scheme.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with the endpoint scheme and the next handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, ensuring HTTPS, and preparing SSE-C parameters for commands.

methods.name: prepareSseParams
methods.description: Prepares SSE-C parameters by encoding the key and MD5 hash, for use in S3 requests.
